title: Peridex CAPD Filter Set
item_service_description: <p> The Peridex Filter Set is used by home continuous ambulatory peritoneal dialysis (CAPD) patients. The Peridex Filter Set is designed to provide sterile filtration during infusion of the dialysis solution in a beneficiary's peritoneal cavity; included in the filter set is a bacterial filter designed to block peritonitis-causing organisms and thus reduce the incidence of peritonitis.</p>
indications_limitations: <p> Based upon advice of our medical consultants, we have determined that the Peridex CAPD Filter Set cannot be covered at this time by Medicare because it has not yet been shown to be safe and effective in preventing peritonitis.</p>
revision_history: <p> 05/1989 - Re-categorized dialysis equipment from DME to Home Dialysis Supplies and Equipment for coverage purposes. Effective date NA. (TN 36)  </p>
